name: Recital P
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: whereas the 2024 World Press Freedom Index by Reporters Without Borders (RSF) warns of a decline in the intent of states and other political forces to protect press freedom; whereas, according to RSF, 47 journalists and media workers have been killed, most of them in conflict zones, and 573 have been imprisoned since 1 January 2024;
